digest.component_or_area: capability registry and optional dependency enforcement
propositions: Create a stdlib-only semantic capability registry independent of command registry, mapping semantic keys to packaging extras and typed missing postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback).

Enforce capability checks only at selected execution boundaries after mode/backend selection (e.g., audit serve before audit show, Bedrock construction before provider selection) to preserve lean diagnostic paths.
Validate that every capability references a declared packaging extra, every route's possible capability name exists, and no probe imports its optional package during registry construction.
Expose a narrow shared error helper for error-posture capabilities that raises OptionalDependencyError only at the boundary, while unavailable/abstain/fallback postures remain domain-controlled.

Preserve existing install guidance, exit types, and degraded output shapes; keep stable verbs and top-level help present in no-extras wheels; maintain _optional.require_extra and guard_import as compatibility surfaces.
Keep mcp_server and review_bot as separate entry-point capabilities reusable without adding CLI verbs, validated absent from the top-level route registry.
